subject: Discount docket: fiscal sweep & pricing handoff for Q4 commits
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Discount docket: fiscal sweep & pricing handoff for Q4 commits

Team —

We need a quick sweep of the outstanding price exceptions that are currently inflating (or risking) our Q4 committed ARR. Finance asked for clarity by EOD tomorrow so they can lock the forecast. Action items below: 

1) Identify which deals have signed MAs/IOs and therefore should be treated as committed even with concessions
2) For deals lacking legal sign-off, mark concessions as contingent and move to the pipeline adjustment queue
3) Deal Desk (Karthik) to provide final approved concession values or explicit RLS (reduced list of concessions)
4) Owners to update HubSpot deal records with the concession justification link

Attached: discount_docket_Q4.xlsx (summary), handoff_notes.md (quick guidance).

I've flagged BrightForge as highest priority — they asked for an aggressive discount during procurement review and we need to decide classification for forecast purposes.

Please reply with a short line-per-deal status. No long threads — bullets only.

Thanks,
Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Diego: +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discount docket: fiscal sweep & pricing handoff for Q4 commits

Diego —

Quick status (bullets as requested):
- BrightForge (owner: me): proposal v3 attached; procurement looped. They have an internal PO pending — procurement asked for one-week extension on approval.
- CloudHaven (owner: Marissa): under legal review; no signed IO yet — treat concession as contingent.
- Halcyon Labs (owner: Karthik): verbal okay from executive sponsor; legal to sign this week — tentatively committed, but concession needs Deal Desk sign-off.

Karthik — please confirm final concession caps for Halcyon and BrightForge so Finance can classify. I attached brightforge_proposal_v3.pdf to show the concession line items.

Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales Director, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discount docket: fiscal sweep & pricing handoff for Q4 commits

Thanks for the summary. I've run the numbers and attached the concession_tracker.csv with recommended caps per account. High-level: 
- BrightForge: approval threshold exceeded by $45k ARR. We can approve up to $30k under discretionary authority; remainder requires SDR (VP Sales) sign-off.
- Halcyon Labs: within approval band if contract signs by 10/15 — consider tentatively committed pending DocuSign.
- CloudHaven: mark contingent; no further action until legal signs.

Requests: 
- Vanessa/Diego: add quick justification (1-2 lines) to the HubSpot deal for BrightForge pointing to procurement ask. Link: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/DF-BRG-1142
- Marissa: please push CloudHaven legal owner a reminder today.

I'll escalate the $15k gap for BrightForge to VP for final decision — expect reply by tomorrow midday.

Attachments: concession_tracker.csv

Karthik Iyer
Head of Deal Desk, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@brightforge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightForge Procurement <procurement@brightforge.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 08:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Discount docket: fiscal sweep & pricing handoff for Q4 commits

Vanessa / Diego —

Thanks for the update and for sending v3. Procurement needs an internal approval cycle and has asked for a one-week window to finalize the PO. We understand the fiscal timing pressure but can you confirm the following so we can expedite: 
1) Is the quoted discount the absolute maximum available to BrightForge?
2) If BrightForge signs within the extension, will the concession be honored retroactively for the Q4 booking?

Procurement is copied (procurement@brightforge.com). We aim to complete sign-off by 10/18. If anything changes on your side that would impact classification, please advise immediately.

Best,
Laura Chen
Director of Procurement, BrightForge
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 12:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discount docket: fiscal sweep & pricing handoff for Q4 commits — finance guidance

Team —

Thank you for the quick updates. Finance guidance for forecast treatment below (summary):
- BrightForge: until we have a signed PO/IO, do NOT count the discounted portion as committed ARR. Count only the base ARR (non-discounted) as committed for the Q4 lock. Any concession applied after signature can be reclassified in the subsequent quarter after revenue adjustment.
- Halcyon Labs: tentatively committed — mark as committed in the forecast only if DocuSign is completed by 2027-10-15; otherwise move to contingent.
- CloudHaven: contingent. Do not include in committed ARR.

Please update HubSpot with the following tags: "forecast:committed", "forecast:contingent-discount", and include the link to the concession justification. I've provided a template for the forecast adjustment in the attachment — use that to submit any post-signing reclassifications.

Attachments: forecast_adjustment_template.csv

Monica Patel
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
